report.summary: Observed: the astronomy-shop PostgreSQL instance is rejecting authentication for database user "otelu". Postgres pod postgresql-6bd9b846cb-5gqst logs repeated 'FATAL: password authentication failed for user "otelu"' from 09:07:45Z through the end of the sampled window (09:08:06Z), and both database-backed services show that error in their own spans: product-catalog's ListProducts span carries 'failed to load products: failed to query products: pq: password authentication failed for user "otelu"', and the frontend's GetProductReviews client span carries 'connection to server at "postgresql" (10.96.98.227), port 5432 failed: FATAL: password authentication failed for user "otelu"'. The Postgres instance was initialized fresh at 09:06:33-09:06:38 and ran /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init.sql (CREATE ROLE logged) from ConfigMap postgresql-init, whose init.sql defines 'CREATE USER otelu WITH PASSWORD 'otelp_7k9m2q4x''. Every caller of user otelu fails while the DB itself is up, so the fault is a credential mismatch on the otelu role; because secrets cannot be read and the consumer passwords are redacted, the side holding the wrong secret cannot be proven. Leading (unproven) hypothesis: the otelu credential in ConfigMap postgresql-init is the injected fault, since three independently configured DB consumers (product-catalog, product-reviews and accounting) all fail at once against a freshly initialized DB. Consequences observed with their own evidence: product-catalog and product-reviews error spans, recommendation error spans, frontend HTTP 500s on /api/products/{productId}, /api/product-reviews/[productId]/index and /api/recommendations, frontend-proxy 500s and load-generator 500 responses / elevated failure ratios (GET /api/cart 0.49, GET /api/products/6E92ZMYYFZ 0.81, GET /api/recommendations?productIds=LS4PSXUNUM 0.86 at 09:07:59Z). Ruled out as the cause: flagd feature flags (all defaultVariant off), the ad ServiceEndpointDown probe alert (blackbox probes were 0 for every astronomy-shop target during 09:05-09:07 and returned 1 at 09:08), and the POST /api/checkout 100% failure (only observed checkout error spans are ECONNREFUSED to the checkout pod at 09:07:22-09:07:26 while it was starting). All 23 deployments show 1/1 available/ready and all pods are Running with 0 restarts, so this is an application/credential failure, not a pod crash.

The recommendation service's own span 'get_product_list' and its client span oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts failed (status ERROR / gRPC 13) with the product-catalog details 'failed to load products: failed to query products: pq: password authentication failed for user "otelu"', and its ListRecommendations returned '2 UNKNOWN'.

frontend spans for GET /api/products/{productId}, GET /api/recommendations and GET /api/product-reviews/[productId]/index returned HTTP 500 with otel.status_code=ERROR at 2026-11-22T09:07:58-09:08:06Z, frontend-proxy spans 'GET'/'router frontend egress' returned HTTP 500, and load-generator spans 'GET' returned HTTP 500.

product-catalog spans also returned gRPC 5 NOT_FOUND 'Product Not Found: 66VCHSJNUP' and 'Product Not Found: 9SIQT8TOJO' for catalogue product IDs that exist in the seed data at 2026-11-22T09:08:05-09:08:06Z, i.e. product lookups failing after the DB query failed.

Load-generator failure ratios at 2026-11-22T09:07:59Z over a 2-minute window: GET /api/cart 0.49, GET /api/products/6E92ZMYYFZ 0.81, GET /api/products/OLJCESPC7Z 0.43, GET /api/products/0PUK6V6EV0 0.30, GET /api/recommendations?productIds=LS4PSXUNUM 0.86, POST /api/checkout 1.0.

locust_errors series for job locust-astronomy-shop contain 'HTTPError('500 Server Error: Internal Server Error for url: /api/cart')', '/api/checkout', '/api/product-reviews/...', '/api/products/...', '/api/recommendations?...', '/api/data/?contextKeys=accessories', plus 503 errors for url '/' and '/api/cart'.

All 23 astronomy-shop Deployments show 1 desired / 1 available / 1 ready replica and all astronomy-shop pods are Running with container restart counts of 0 (no CrashLoopBackOff, no waiting reason, no terminated reason).

Deployment ScalingReplicaSet events show every astronomy-shop deployment (including postgresql at 09:06:27Z) scaled up from 0 to 1 at 09:06:25-09:06:28Z, and product-catalog, accounting and product-reviews rolled to new ReplicaSets at 09:07:35-09:07:48Z (product-catalog 6bc6bd6ff4 -> 9f946bcfd -> 76b8f9fbf9 -> 777bb7fd5f).

blackbox probe_success for every astronomy-shop target (including ad.astronomy-shop:8080, cart, checkout, product-catalog, product-reviews) was 0 at 09:05:00, 09:06:00 and 09:07:00Z and returned 1 at 09:08:00Z.

Flagd-injected fault rejected: ConfigMap flagd-config demo.flagd.json has every flag (productCatalogFailure, cartFailure, paymentFailure, adFailure, recommendationCacheFailure, kafkaQueueProblems, failedReadinessProbe, emailMemoryLeak, llm*, imageSlowLoad, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, adHighCpu, adManualGc) at state ENABLED with defaultVariant 'off'.

The pending ServiceEndpointDown alert for ad.astronomy-shop:8080 was rejected as this incident's cause: its blackbox probe_success was 0 only during environment start-up (09:05-09:07Z) and had returned to 1 at 09:08:00Z.

The 100% POST /api/checkout failure was rejected as evidence of a separate sustained fault: the only observed checkout error spans (09:07:22Z and 09:07:26Z) show '14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.96.100.65:8080' (checkout endpoint not yet reachable during rollout), and no checkout error span was returned for 09:07:40-09:08:08Z.

Leading hypothesis for the root cause: the otelu credential held in ConfigMap astronomy-shop/postgresql-init (CREATE USER otelu WITH PASSWORD 'otelp_7k9m2q4x' in init.sql) is the altered setting; the DB was initialized from that file at 09:06:37Z and now rejects user otelu from all three independently configured DB clients (product-catalog via secret product-catalog-db-conn, product-reviews and accounting via their own inline connection strings), which is best explained by one DB-side credential rather than three client-side changes.

Alternative hypothesis not excluded: the credentials on the client side were altered (secret product-catalog-db-conn DB_CONNECTION_STRING and/or the inline DB_CONNECTION_STRING of product-reviews and accounting); the configmap value may be the original and the consumers' values the injected ones.

Third possible mechanism (unverified): the otelu role password was changed at runtime after initialization (a single 'FATAL: terminating connection due to administrator command' at 09:07:48Z is consistent with backends being terminated, but no statement/actor is visible in the logs).

The load-generator's elevated GET /api/cart failure ratio (0.49 at 09:07:59Z) is likely a consequence of the same product-catalog DB failure (the frontend cart route resolves product details through product-catalog), but no error span from the cart service itself was returned to prove that path.

Compare the otelu password actually in effect for the DB role with the DB_CONNECTION_STRING values used by product-catalog (secret product-catalog-db-conn), product-reviews and accounting; align them and restart the consumers (if the ConfigMap init.sql is the altered artifact, restore the original otelu password and either re-initialize the postgres data directory or run ALTER ROLE otelu WITH PASSWORD ...).

gaps: Secrets cannot be read: the DB_CONNECTION_STRING stored in secret product-catalog-db-conn and the credential values in the accounting/product-reviews env are redacted, so which side of the otelu credential mismatch was changed cannot be verified.

The change_history integration is not available for this Run, so when (or whether) postgresql-init init.sql or the consumers' connection strings were modified cannot be established; the cluster objects read are their state at query time, after the incident window.

accounting is a third consumer of the otelu role, but no error log line or error span from accounting was observed in the window; whether its DB writes (order persistence via Kafka) are failing is unknown.
No error span from the cart service itself was returned for the sampled window, so whether cart contributed to the /api/cart 500s or only frontend product lookups did is unverified.
No checkout error spans exist in the sample for 09:07:40-09:08:08Z, so the state of checkout after the initial ECONNREFUSED burst is unknown.

Metrics for traces (traces_span_metrics_calls_total / duratio![p) are not present in this Prometheus target, so per-service span error-rate time series could not be used; the evidence is span samples and locust/blackbox metrics.
The exact upstream/original value of the otelu password is not visible in any readable object, so the claim that postgresql-init holds the modified value remains a hypothesis.
next_steps: Have a human with secret read access compare secret astronomy-shop/product-catalog-db-conn DB_CONNECTION_STRING and the accounting/product-reviews DB_CONNECTION_STRING against the otelu password in ConfigMap postgresql-init.
Check the platform's change history/audit log for edits to ConfigMap postgresql-init or to those DB credentials around 09:06-09:08Z on 2026-11-22.

After aligning the credential, re-test product-catalog ListProducts, product-reviews GetProductReviews, recommendation ListRecommendations and frontend /api/products, /api/cart, /api/recommendations endpoints.
